Exama Guide

Unlock your full potential

Welcome to Your Digital Classroom

Exama is packed with advanced tools to track your syllabus, boost your calculation speed, and analyze your mistakes using AI. Scroll down to master every feature.

NOVA Mentor Mentor

Artificial Intelligence
Where to find it

Dashboard Academics NOVA Mentor

How to use it (A to Z)
  • 1 Chat for Study Plans: Open the NOVA Chat and ask for a custom timetable based on your weakest subjects. NOVA remembers your entire exam history!
  • 2 Review Exam Mistakes: After a subjective exam is graded, open your Result. Click "View NOVA Feedback" to see exactly where your formula or logic went wrong, line by line.
  • 3 Visual Doubt Solver: Stuck on a math problem? Upload the photo directly into the NOVA chat, and it will solve it step-by-step.

Live CBT Exams

Testing Engine
Where to find it

Dashboard Active & Pending Exams

How to use it (A to Z)
  • 1 Enter Room: If the exam says "Live Now", click Enter Room to start. If it's an "Anytime" exam, you can start it whenever you are ready.
  • 2 Navigation Palette: Use the right sidebar (or mobile drawer) to jump between questions. Green means answered, Red means skipped, Purple means marked for review.
  • 3 Submission: Always click "Save & Next" to lock in an answer. When the timer hits zero, the app will auto-submit and calculate your score instantly.

60s Math Sprint

Brain Training
Where to find it

Dashboard Academics Math Workout

How to use it (A to Z)
  • 1 Setup: Select the operations you want to practice (Addition, Squares, Percentages, etc.) and pick a difficulty level.
  • 2 The Sprint: You have exactly 60 seconds. Calculate in your head and type the answer using the on-screen numpad.
  • 3 Auto-Advance: Do not press enter! As soon as you type the correct answer, the screen flashes green and automatically jumps to the next question.

Material Hub & Auto-Quiz

Resources
Where to find it

Dashboard Academics Material Hub

How to use it (A to Z)
  • 1 Read Offline: Click the icon next to any PDF or Image to save it permanently to your device for offline reading.
  • 2 Magic Auto-Quiz: While reading any PDF in the document viewer, click the "Auto Quiz" button at the top. NOVA will instantly scan the pages you are reading and build a 20-question Mock Test!

Deep Focus Sessions

Productivity
Where to find it

Dashboard Community Focus Sessions

How to use it (A to Z)
  • 1 Start Studying: Choose a session block (e.g., Morning Session) and hit Start. The sci-fi HUD timer will track your deep work down to the second.
  • 2 Take Accurate Breaks: Always hit "Take Break" when you leave your desk. The app tracks your Study-to-Break ratio to make sure you aren't burning out.
  • 3 Live Motivation: Scroll down to see exactly which of your classmates are studying live right now. Compete for the #1 spot on the Focus Leaderboard!

Discus Community

Social Study
Where to find it

Dashboard Community Discus

How to use it (A to Z)
  • 1 Chat & Mentions: Discuss topics with classmates. Type `@` to tag a specific student and send them a push notification directly to their phone.
  • 2 Share Performance: Click the trophy icon next to the chat bar to instantly generate and share your real-time performance scorecard into the group!
  • 3 Live Study Rooms: Click the Video/Phone icons at the top right to start a secure, encrypted Jitsi group call for late-night study sessions.

Goal Forecaster & Targets

Planning
Where to find it

Dashboard Tracking Target Planner

How to use it (A to Z)
  • 1 Set the Dream: Open the Target Planner and type in the final percentage you want to achieve by the end of the year (e.g., 90%).
  • 2 The Algorithm: The app mathematically analyzes your past exam scores and calculates exactly how many marks you need to get in *upcoming* scheduled exams to hit that target.
  • 3 Weekly Tasks: Go to "Weekly Targets" to check off your daily homework and syllabus completion tasks assigned by the faculty to ensure you hit that goal!

Built for Your Success

Thank you for using Exama. This platform was built with passion to redefine how students prepare for competitive exams. Keep pushing your limits, stay focused, and crack it!

Developed By Subhankar Sarkar
